metadata.Research Paper: Causal Ordering and Monotonicity in a Aether-Continuum Lamport Clock Implementation
metadata.Research Domain: No Effect Before Its Cause: From Einstein to Lamport

workers.abstract: We investigate the causal ordering guarantees of a lightweight Lamport clock implementation in Aether-Continuum, focusing on the invariant that no effect can precede its cause. The design preserves monotonicity and causal precedence through local increments and remote updates, yielding a formally verified ordering relation. We present a theorem that any two events with a causal relation are assigned strictly increasing timestamps, and we prove this invariant using a simple induction over the event graph. Static analysis of the Aether-Continuum source confirms that the algorithmic complexity of increment, update, and timestamp retrieval is O(1), while the overall structure satisfies the required asymptotic bounds for distributed event ordering. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Aether-Continuum-concurrency-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261112_010253_no_effect_before_its_cause__fr.
proof_lines: [1] We investigate the causal ordering guarantees of a lightweight Lamport clock implementation in Aether-Continuum, focusing on the invariant that no effect can precede its cause.
[2] The design preserves monotonicity and causal precedence through local increments and remote updates, yielding a formally verified ordering relation.
[3] We present a theorem that any two events with a causal relation are assigned strictly increasing timestamps, and we prove this invariant using a simple induction over the event graph.

[4] Static analysis of the Aether-Continuum source confirms that the algorithmic complexity of increment, update, and timestamp retrieval is O(1), while the overall structure satisfies the required asymptotic bounds for distributed event ordering.
[5] The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Aether-Continuum-concurrency-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261112_010253_no_effect_before_its_cause__fr.
